_comment: Single source of truth for crawler-facing SEO. Consumed by scripts/generate-sitemap.js (writes public/sitemap.xml + public/robots.txt at build time) and by vite-plugin-seo.js (canonical + og:url + JSON-LD in index.html). Set the SITE_URL env var to override `siteUrl` without editing this file — this is REQUIRED on any host, because the domain differs per service.
_siteUrlWarning: `siteUrl` below is a DEVELOPMENT FALLBACK ONLY. On every deploy the SITE_URL env var overrides it, so this value should never be your live domain. If you see it in a production sitemap, SITE_URL was not set on the platform.
_routesComment: Public, crawlable routes ONLY. Authenticated areas (/admin/*, /portal, /login, /dashboard) must never be listed — see the Disallow rules generated into robots.txt.
